TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Obtains information about the pricing rule. Allows you to filter by various parameters.
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: reads the optional filters pricingRuleId, fromDate, toDate, activityId, segmentId, settlementId, onlyActive, pageNumber, sizeOfPage, pricingRuleType, pricingRuleStatus, attributeDesc and attributeName. If pricingRuleId is present and negative, it logs "Invalid parameter: pricingRuleId must be non-negative.", adds advice ABKO00000050 with severity 04 - WARNING, initializes dataOfPricingRules.pricingRules as an empty list, sets dataOfPricingRules and returns. 2. Decisions and branches: otherwise it builds PricingRuleGetFilterParams with all input values and continues with the library call. 3. Libraries and methods invoked: it calls ABKOR000.executeGetPricingRules(filterParams). The library builds base query parameters, defaults pageNumber and pageSize to 1 and 10 when they are missing or non-positive, converts missing identifiers to -1, converts missing fromDate and toDate to 1900-01-01 and 9990-12-31, maps onlyActive to the active flag, expands pricingRuleStatus through FilterStatusEnum or direct uppercase codes, uppercases non-empty pricingRuleType values, runs the count query, builds paginationOut, and when data exists queries and maps each row into pricing rules, effectiveDate, fee, segment, settlement, paymentMethods, customAttributes and activities. 4. Errors and follow-up actions: if the returned pricingRules list is empty, it logs "No Data Founded.", adds advice ABKO00000040 and sets severity 04 - WARNING. No additional advices are emitted by the invoked library method or its reachable helpers. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: it always calls setDataofpricingrules with the DataPricingRuleGet prepared in the current branch; in the negative identifier branch the output contains an empty pricingRules list, and after the library call it returns the mapped pricing rules together with the pagination data.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Retrieves pricing rules with the received filters, builds pagination data from the count query, and maps the result rows to the transaction output structure.
